findings.title: Do not let failed JWT engines consume successful-user cache slots. `engine_for` inserts each new engine before `get_token` performs the federation. A failed exc
findings.label: incorrect
findings.note: New engines go into pending, not the LRU, and settle() on Err removes the engine from pending and from the cache, so failed engines never take cache slots.

findings.title: Remove the pending engine when `get_token` is cancelled. `engine_for` inserts a new engine into `engines.pending` at Line 225. Only `settle` removes it.
findings.label: incorrect
findings.note: get_token_for_jwt wraps the engine in an InFlight guard whose Drop removes the pending entry when the future is cancelled, so the cancelled engine is already cleaned up.

findings.label: incorrect
findings.note: @cipherstash/auth is at 0.44.1, where a minor bump is the semver-breaking bump, so asking for a major version is a misreading.
